description: Tufts Animal Care and Condition (TACC) Weather Safety Scale & Veterinary Cold Thresholds
source: Cummings School of Veterinary Medicine at Tufts University

temperature_bands.name: No Risk
temperature_bands.description: No cold hazard for any dog size or coat type.

temperature_bands.name: Low / Mild Risk
temperature_bands.description: Generally safe. Mild discomfort possible for toy breeds or very thin single coats.

temperature_bands.name: Moderate Risk
temperature_bands.description: Caution advised. Prolonged exposure causes hypothermia in small dogs, puppies, and seniors.

temperature_bands.name: Severe Risk
temperature_bands.description: Dangerous for all dogs except arctic double-coated breeds. Outings restricted to <15-20 mins.

temperature_bands.name: Critical Hazard
temperature_bands.description: Life-threatening frostbite and rapid hypothermia hazard. Limit outdoor exposure strictly to brief potty breaks.
